repository_entries.description: Pin installation to stable v1.0.0 and record verified publication acceptance and the maintained v1 compatibility commitment.
Specify additional Kafka registry wire modes, concrete framing gaps and optional adapter acceptance.
Define additional Validation dialect and extension compatibility without changing current defaults.
Design bounded KMS materials caching with explicit ownership, atomic limits and preserved uncached defaults.
Assess Managed Instances lifecycle, native Go worker support and dedicated composed-runtime acceptance.
Define optional durable execution integration and preserve the separate Idempotency response-replay contract.
Specify a bounded opt-in AWS IAM/KMS/SSM/DynamoDB acceptance plan with explicit authorization and cleanup.
Add four issue priority labels and document consistent manual triage.

# v1.1.0

All maintained public modules move to this version. Modules without file changes receive a version bump only.

**Scope:** 1 modules with changes; 26 version bumps only.

**Source:** [fd553baf981f](https://github.com/rambow-cloud/powertools-lambda-go/tree/fd553baf981f28877310b9cdc302435304808269)
